# The Last Line

> Free-to-play zombie barricade shooter for iPhone, iPad and Android by Rigbak. Hold the barricade against up to 150 zombies at once, scavenge ruined cities for resources, and face Souls-style arena bosses.

- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (iOS), Android
- Price: free to play, with in-app purchases and ads
- Version 1.0 release: 10 September 2026 on the App Store, 11 September 2026 on Google Play
- Players: single-player
- Languages: game text in 46 languages, campaign voice-over in 10
- Engine: Unreal Engine 5
- Developer and publisher: Rigbak (https://rigbak.com)
- Contact: thelastline@rigbak.com

## Download

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-last-line-zombie-siege/id6756308513): The Last Line: Zombie Siege for iPhone and iPad.
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rigbak.thelastline): The Last Line for Android.
